title: ARIA convergence pipeline broken at bridge layer — challenger agent result never folded into plan_state

root_cause_layers.description: The bridge component that translates agent_invocations/results.jsonl row (challenger plan submission) into a plan_state transition (DRAFT → CHALLENGER_DRAFTED) is non-functional. Despite challenger subprocess executing successfully (real Claude, ~2 min wall-clock) and the result envelope landing in results.jsonl with status=accepted, plan_state's current_state remains null and has_challenger_field=false at the 10-min poll timeout. The convergent_planning_bridge or cross_review_bridge listener is the broken link.
root_cause_layers.evidence_pointer: smoking_gun_plan_state_at_timeout above + agent_invocations/results.jsonl row for AIR-aria-challenger-planner-* request_ids accepted
root_cause_layers.fix_anchor: investigate convergent_planning_bridge.py + cross_review_bridge.py listener registration; find which component should call start_convergent_plan_drafted_by_primary/update_challenger_drafted on result receipt

root_cause_layers.description: subprocess_env_audit confirmed AISAFETY-HIGH-001 hypothesis: outer Claude Code session leaks CLAUDECODE=1, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH into spawned `claude --print` child process. Child treats itself as nested Claude session — may share per-OAuth-token rate-limit pool with parent, may pull parent's conversation history via session_id resume.
root_cause_layers.fix_anchor: tools/aria-poc/ci_executor.py:841 — construct subprocess env from {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('CLAUDE_','CLAUDECODE'))} + re-inject kernel-managed allowlist

root_cause_layers.description: cost_attribution_missing fired 2x across 2 diagnostic cycles. Despite real Claude calls completing with non-zero cost in agent_invocations/outputs/*.md (claude_cli_total_cost_usd field present), no row is appended to aria-tools/cost-attribution/2026-05.jsonl. Cost row writer is silently bypassed when cycle convergence_blocks (vs. converges).
root_cause_layers.fix_anchor: budget.py record_cost_attribution callsite — investigate why ci_executor success path skips the write when cycle terminates in convergence_blocked
